key_findings: DBZ alleviates CFA-induced inflammatory pain and anxiety-like behaviors and reduces ACC astrocyte activation and cytokines.
DBZ blocks CFA-induced JAK2/STAT3 phosphorylation and Fyn/GluN2B/GluA1 upregulation in the ACC.
